title: DISCERN: Preserve at Write, Resolve at Read for Persistent LLM-Agent Memory
abstract: arXiv:2611.15729v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Enterprise agents accumulate memory across dozens of sessions in which facts contradict, get superseded, and blur as similarly named entities collide in embedding space. The field treats this as a retrieval problem; we show it is not. On ENT-310, a synthetic enterprise sales-agent memory benchmark of 310 queries (210 answerable, 100 unanswerable), a vanilla Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) reader over a memory store already matches strong memory systems on the recall pillars. Retention and currency are near-saturated, roughly 0.93 to 0.98 for every competent system, so recall is essentially solved. What remains unsolved is resolution: which entity a query refers to, which time-state is current, and whether to commit an answer at all or decline when evidence is insufficient. translated_title: DISCERN：面向持久化LLM智能体记忆的“写入时保留、读取时消解”框架
translated_abstract: 企业智能体在数十个会话中不断积累记忆，其中事实相互矛盾、被新信息取代，并因名称相似的实体在嵌入空间中发生碰撞而变得模糊不清。该领域一直将此视为检索问题；我们证明它并非如此。在ENT-310（一个包含310个查询的合成企业销售智能体记忆基准，其中210个可回答、100个不可回答）上，基于记忆存储的普通检索增强生成（RAG）读取器在召回相关维度上已经能够与强大的记忆系统相匹敌。记忆保留性和时效性已接近饱和，所有合格系统的得分大致在0.93到0.98之间，因此召回问题本质上已被解决。真正尚未解决的是消解问题：查询究竟指代哪个实体、哪个时间状态是最新的，以及是否应当给出答案，还是在证据不足时选择拒答。我们提出了DISCERN（消歧与跨会话情景记忆导航），一个建立在单一规则之上的智能体记忆框架：写入时保留，读取时消解……
tldr: 该论文提出DISCERN智能体记忆框架，指出持久化记忆的核心难题不是检索召回（已近饱和）而是“消解”——包括实体消歧、时间状态判定与证据不足时拒答——并据此提出“写入时保留、读取时消解”的核心原则。
en_tdlr: DISCERN reframes persistent LLM-agent memory as a resolution problem rather than a retrieval one, and introduces a "preserve at write, resolve at read" framework to handle entity disambiguation, temporal currency, and abstention when evidence is insufficient.
